Hidden mentalic Foundation at Star's End.

How Second Foundation connects

  • Character: Hari Seldon — Seldon also plants the hidden Second Foundation.
  • Character: Preem Palver — Palver is First Speaker of the Second Foundation.
  • Location: Trantor — The Second Foundation hides at Star's End near Trantor.

What is Second Foundation?

The Second Foundation is Seldon's secret counterpart — telepaths who guard the Plan from the shadows, later revealed near Trantor.

Key threads lead to Hari Seldon, Preem Palver and Trantor.
